第25章 降临倒计时-《开局三预言？我直播通关S级末世》

与她猜测得差不多，官方发觉了诡气的存在，这种异常在持续侵扰人类的生活，并且有扩大的趋势。

特战队的成立，就是专门为了应对这些特殊事件的。

眼看靳兰玦的七日预言即将成真，与其让民众惶惶茫然，不如由官方出面科普备战，提高人类的存活率。

就在靳兰玦陷入沉睡的这两天，网络上关于如何在诡域中生存的视频已经满天飞。

很多营销号借机混在里面散播毒攻略，不到半天时间就被官方抓起来，公开罪名，罚款关押一气呵成。

就这样雷厉风行处理了三百多号人，网络上胡说八道的情况立刻消失不见。

大家虽然还是在热烈讨论着相关话题，但是官方的行为给了人们足够的安全感，大家都在紧张中等待。

更何况！

靳兰玦的直播间，很大程度缓解了人们的恐惧和焦虑。

只有面对未知，人们才会恐惧。

当大家已经看到了所谓的诡异是什么之后，当大家看到，原来诡异可以被人类对付之后，也就不是那么恐惧了。

有一部分人会想：

哦……原来是这样的，那我使点劲儿应该也可以嘛，大不了跑快点……

总之，因为靳兰玦公开诡异降临的关系，促使官方改变了策略，事件的发展转向了一个与上一世完全不同的方向。

靳兰玦决定加入特战队。

或许，这一世，他们可以争取到与上一世截然不同的结果呢？

上午10:55。

市区车流密密麻麻，一点点龟速行驶。

以防万一，整个市中心所有的人全部疏散，不论是居民还是公司，周围三公里以内，所有人全部退出。

不只是地面，天上直升机来来往往，也在运输人群撤离。

靳氏集团大楼。

自从老板靳建国贩卖自己的亲女儿被抓走之后，整个公司就停工了。

这情况，明显没救了。

几家债主一合计，那就把这栋大楼用来抵债吧！

这几天，三家债主重新划分大楼归属，拆掉了所有关于靳氏集团的装饰，将公司的设备搬进来，开开心心设立了所谓的分公司。

Just as she guessed, the authorities discovered the existence of strange energy. This anomaly continues to intrude on human life and has a tendency to expand.

The special operations team was established specifically to deal with these special events.

Seeing that Jin Lanjue's seven-day prophecy is about to come true, instead of leaving the public in panic and confusion, it is better for the government to come forward to prepare for the war through popular science and improve the survival rate of mankind.

Just two days after Jin Lanjue fell into a deep sleep, videos on how to survive in the treacherous realm were all over the Internet.

Many marketing accounts took the opportunity to spread poison guides. In less than half a day, they were arrested by the authorities, publicly charged, fined and imprisoned.

In this way, more than 300 people were dealt with quickly and resolutely, and the nonsense on the Internet immediately disappeared.

Although everyone is still discussing related topics enthusiastically, the official actions have given people enough sense of security, and everyone is waiting nervously.

not to mention!

Jin Lanjue's live broadcast room has greatly alleviated people's fears and anxieties.

Only when faced with the unknown do people become afraid.

When everyone has seen what the so-called weirdness is, and when everyone has seen that weirdness can be dealt with by humans, they are no longer so scared.

Some people will think:

Oh...it turns out that's how it is, then I should be able to do it with a little more force. At worst, run faster...

In short, because Jin Lanjue disclosed the mysterious arrival, the authorities changed their strategy, and the development of the incident turned in a completely different direction from the previous life.

Jin Lanjue decided to join the special operations team.

Perhaps, in this life, they can achieve completely different results from the previous life?

10:55am.

The urban traffic is dense and moving at a slow speed.

As a precaution, everyone in the entire city center, whether residents or companies, was evacuated, and everyone within three kilometers was evacuated.

Not just on the ground, helicopters are coming and going in the sky, transporting people to evacuate.

Jin Group Building.

Ever since the boss Jin Jianguo was arrested for selling his own daughter, the entire company has stopped working.

This situation is obviously hopeless.

Once several creditors add up, let's use this building to pay off their debts!

In the past few days, the three creditors have reorganized the ownership of the building, removed all the decorations related to the Jin Group, moved the company's equipment in, and happily set up a so-called branch.
